newsitem.title: BELGIUM: WERELDHAVE BIDS FOR ANTWERP SPORTS PALACE.
newsitem.headline: WERELDHAVE BIDS FOR ANTWERP SPORTS PALACE.

text.p: Dutch property fund Wereldhave NV has made a 120 million Belgian francs (6.54 million guilders) bid for the bankrupt Antwerp Sports Palace events hall, an Antwerp city official said on Tuesday.
Antwerp city alderman for finances Hugo Schiltz told Reuters that receivers were expecting at least one more bid before the closing date of March 20.
The Antwerp sports palace is home to major music and sports events such as the European Community tennis championship.
"The city wants the Sports Palace to continue to be used as an events hall," Schiltz said.
He said the receivers would demand from any bidders to honour contracts for events to be organised next season.
The city and province of Antwerp are the main creditors of the Sports Palace, which has a total debt of 400 million francs, including 250 million to the city and province.
Troubled Antwerp-based mortgage and savings bank AnHyp is also a large creditor.
